newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson launches new mobile phone.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson launches new mobile phone.

text.p: Swedish telecoms giant LM Ericsson AB on Wednesday launched a new digital mobile phone, the PH388, building on the success of its PH337 model.
Ericsson said in a statement that the new model was smaller, lighter, easier to use and offered better services than the earlier model through the DCS1800 network.
It weighs 170 grams and offers up to 80 hours stand-by time or five hours talking time.
Ericsson said the phone has been released in France, Germany, Switzerland, and Britain and will be launched later in 1996 in Malaysia, Singapore and Thailand.
At the start of 1997 the telephone will be sold in the rest of Europe and in a large part of southeast Asia.
